name: Uni-Trend Technology (China) Co., Ltd.
summary: Uni-Trend Technology (China) Co., Ltd. designs and manufactures test and measurement instruments worldwide. The company offers various meters, comprising digital multimeters, clamp meters, electrical power tools, power quality analyzers, socket testers, voltage detectors, voltage and continuity testers, SMD testers, and circuit breaker finder; and thermal imaging products, including handheld and smartphone thermal cameras, EST thermal cameras, and thermal imaging monoculars. It also provides various instruments, including oscilloscopes, waveform and RF signal generators, DC power supplies, digital multimeters, LCR meters, AC power source, and spectrum analyzers.
